intro.narration: Inside the computer shop. The fan hums, and so do everyone's nerves. JR still has his headset on.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Sup. Ako si JR, rank one dito. Ikaw 'yung nag-uuphill sa story mode? Cute.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Apo. Nandito lang ako. Panoorin ko kung ano'ng natutunan mo.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Lolo?! Legend. Pero relax tito, di ko kailangan ng coaching—scripted ko na 'tong deal, GG agad.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Scripted? Sa panahon namin, tinatalo ka ng baraha, hindi ng dahilan.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Boomer take, respect. Pero tignan mo—perfect hand ko, meta build.

intro.narration: JR dealt the cards, grinning. You looked at your hand. Tres na kalburo — and two four-of-a-kinds.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Wait. Anong hawak mo? Teka, na-misdeal ba? Lag 'yon, di bilang!

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Hala. Mukhang na-nerf ka, apo mo pala 'yung may script.

intro.speaker: jr_hotshot
intro.text: Okay okay, tahimik na sweatlord, respect. Pero di pa tapos 'to—clutch pa 'ko.

win.speaker: jr_hotshot
win.text: Ubos ka na?! Impossible, may quads ka?! Rigged 'yan, report ko 'to sa admin!

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: Walang admin sa hapag, iho. Meron lang manalo at matalo.

win.narration: JR pulled off his headset. For the first time, the whole shop was silent.

win.speaker: jr_hotshot
win.text: ...okay. GG. Legit ka pala. Wala kang stream? Sayang, viral ka sana.

lose.speaker: jr_hotshot
lose.text: EZ! GG WP! I-clip niyo 'yan—diff talaga ang skill gap!

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Hmp. Suwerte ang script minsan. Balik ka, apo.

lose.speaker: jr_hotshot
lose.text: Rematch anytime, tito. Practice ka muna sa unranked, hehe.

lines.speaker: jr_hotshot
lines.text: FOUR OF A KIND?! Anong build 'yan?! Di 'yan nasa meta!

lines.speaker: jr_hotshot
lines.text: Clear ulit? Lag server 'to, di 'to skill niyo!
